answer: The mirror audit binds one identity to one replayable season: the claimant hands a complete log of their past work to a mirror auditor, who replays every step from scratch and must land on the same result. The log rides the zephyr courier line to the horizon registrar, where two auditors compare their replays within seven days. A log that cannot be replayed, a step skipped, or a second log from the same hand voids the season, burns a 140-credit stake, and bars the claimant for two years. One honest replay costs 140 credits; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 full seasons replayed by hand.
